data.body:
Implemented in local commit 1ae781b63ab (shared with dissocial-unpleasant-adouri and knightly-salty-orangutan).

- `eval_scorers.py`: `_schema_plan_review_findings` (dict + list `findings`, `passes.register_contracts()` then `contracts.response_model_for("plan_review_findings").model_validate`, non-empty `finding`); `emits_valid_findings` now maps to it. `_attributes_criterion` credits an exact case-insensitive `criteria` element match before the old substring check.
- Measured deviation in the self-registration test: `import rebar` already imports `rebar.llm.plan_review.passes`, so "passes not in sys.modules" can never hold in a fresh interpreter. The test instead removes `plan_review_findings` from the contract registry in a fresh interpreter, then scores a Pass-1 output and asserts it passes and that the contract was re-registered. This proves the same thing: the scorer registers the contract itself and does not fall back to review_result.
- Offline evidence: 44 scorer tests pass; 13 of the new ones fail against origin/main 05c6414358f code, including all 7 parametrized criterion-id specs with the `'dimension'` error.
- No live run: the failure is a deterministic scorer/shape mismatch, reproduced and verified offline.
- Portability: pure in-process validation; the fresh-interpreter test uses `subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", ...])`, an argument list with no shell, fds or POSIX paths.
